title: Cross-referencing Tasmanian vegetation map (TASVEG 5.0) to the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology: 90m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis
description:
This dataset provides a 90 m spatial synthesis and tabular lookup cross-referencing Tasmania's statewide vegetation map (TASVEG 5.0; 156 mapping units across mainland Tasmania and surrounding islands) to Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups (EFGs) of the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (IUCN GET).

Cross-referencing relationships were established by five domain experts across two rounds of structured expert elicitation using fuzzy membership values. This package provides the synthesised best-candidate ('winner-takes-all') spatial layers from Round 2 (153 eligible vegetation community units mapped to 21 IUCN GET Ecosystem Functional Groups, with 3 non-eligible natural mapping units—OAQ Water/sea, ORO Lichen lithosere, and OSM Sand/mud—set to NoData), along with pixel-level membership proportions, number of supporting interpreters, tabular cross-reference tables, and GIS styling files.

Attribution requirement: Spatial layers are derived from TASVEG 5.0 from www.theLIST.tas.gov.au ©State of Tasmania (CC BY 3.0 AU).
